movelist.name: Splash
movelist.effect: Shift Action - The user may make a single Jump, adding +1 to their Long Jump and High Jump values, and gains +2 Evasion until the end of their next turn.

movelist.name: Encore
movelist.effect: Roll 1d6. On a result of 1 or 2, the target becomes Confused; on a result of 3 or 4 the target becomes Suppressed; on a result of 5 or 6 the target becomes Enraged.

movelist.name: Charm
movelist.effect: Charm lowers the target’s Attack 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Weeble
abilities.trigger: The user is hit by a damaging attack
abilities.effect: The user may make an AC4 Physical Attack against an adjacent target. If the attack hits, the target loses Hit Points equal to 1/3rd of the damage taken by the user from the attack that triggered Weeble.
